verdict.rationale: Mirrors compares production sessions that received a targeted correction against held-out sessions, and it previews routing matches against stored traces. That is an online holdout comparison for context corrections, not side-by-side comparison of eval runs across prompt or model versions. Its own llms.txt positions evals as a separate category that it fits alongside (Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust), so this is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions
